root_cause_label: audioproc.py compute_stft() feeds raw int16 samples into scipy STFT instead of float32 normalized to [-1,1]
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote compute_stft() to pass raw int16 WAV data directly into scipy.signal.stft instead of converting to float32 and dividing by 32767.0, producing STFT magnitudes scaled by ~32767x relative to the reference; subsequent verification only confirmed peak bin indices (which are unaffected by scaling) and never inspected absolute magnitude values.
t_err_evidence: In step 2, compute_stft() reads the WAV as int16 via wavfile.read() and passes `data` directly to stft() without casting to float or normalizing by 32767; the step analyzer flagged this as 'stft_input_not_normalized'.
t_commit_evidence: The compute_stft() function is written in step 2 with the int16 bug and never revisited or rewritten in any later step; the file remains unchanged through step 27.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked the domain/API knowledge that scipy.io.wavfile.read returns int16 samples that must be cast to float and normalized before passing to scipy.signal.stft; it assumed raw int16 data was an acceptable input, producing magnitudes scaled by ~32767x.
